whatsNew: Pinch-to-zoom is now enabled in the Android app, with the app starting at a compact 85% zoom by default.
The bottom-center home control is smaller and redesigned with a premium gold finish, halo, depth and stronger visibility.
The Android launch screen now uses the full E-Football logo on a branded dark background instead of a blank white startup screen.
The homepage Menu control and drawer now use a higher-contrast cinematic glass treatment so they remain clearly visible over the background.
Admin App Updater now has Refresh version, which reads the latest Android version, build and What's New notes from the release files and stages them without triggering the update.
Android release metadata and the website footer are prepared for v1.0.47, build 48.
